findings.label: Large-title collapse deferred (non-blocking)
findings.detail: R10's native collapsing "Apps" title is not implemented; an in-screen large title that scrolls with the list is used because the JS @react-navigation/stack lacks headerLargeTitle. Accepted per plan D1 and documented in the manual checklist; revisit when the navigator migrates to native-stack (BuildList task). No action required for this pass.
